content.text: Talai hoi athung e hno kaawm naw pueng BAWIPA e doeh.
Talai hoi avan e kaawm e taminaw pueng hai amae doeh.
tuipui dawk adu a ung teh,
tuinaw dawk acaksak.
BAWIPA mon dawk apimaw ka luen thai han.
A bawkim kathoung vah apimaw ka kâen thai han
Tawksaknae hoi lungthin a thoung teh,
kahrai ka bawk hoeh e, dumyennae lawkkamnae ka sak hoeh e naw hah
a luen thai awh vaiteh a kâen thai awh han.
BAWIPA ni yawhawinae a poe vaiteh,
ahnimouh kaie rungngangnae Cathut ni
na yon hoeh atipouh awh han.
Hot patetlah, taminaw teh
Cathut koe ka phat thai e taminaw doeh.
Jakop e Cathut hmalah ka tâcawt thai e doeh.
Oe longkhanaw na lû loungouk awh haw.
Yungyoe takhangnaw loungouk awh haw.
Bawilennae Siangpahrang teh a kâen han.
Ka lentoe e Siangpahrang teh apimaw
BAWIPA teh athakasai ni teh athakaawme,
BAWIPA teh taran tuknae hmuen koe athakaawme doeh.
Oe longkhanaw na lû loungouk awh haw
Yungyoe takhangnaw loungouk awh haw.
Bawilennae Siangpahrang teh a kâen han.
Bawilennae Siangpahrang teh apimaw
Ama teh ransahu BAWIPA,
ka lentoe e Siangpahrang doeh.
